consent.title: Before you start
consent.intro: Here's what {{appName}} keeps about your child, and why. It takes a minute to read.
consent.introSchool: Here's what {{school}} keeps about your child in {{appName}}, and why. It takes a minute to read.
consent.collect1: Your child's profile and therapy records
consent.collect2: Session notes your school shares with you
consent.why: So everyone working with your child stays on the same page, even when therapists change.
consent.who: Your child's therapists and school staff. Other parents never see it.
consent.choices: You can ask for a copy or for deletion anytime, from More → Consent & privacy.
consent.agree: I agree to my child's information being used as described above
consent.video: Allow me to upload short practice videos
consent.videoHint: Optional. Videos stay private to your child's care team and are deleted automatically after {{days}} days.
